evidence.note: claim: the ci gate's own timer (timeout_s) wraps `ddflow ci run --timeout N`, which queues up to N for the suite lock inside it, so queue wait eats the run budget; mechanism: gates/runner._run_holding_the_suite_lock holds no lock for a ddflow-ci command (_runs_ddflow_ci) and passes gdef.timeout_s to CommandRunner. Refuter: the runner-level test shows timeout_s passed = 7200 for a 3600 ci command; it failed (7200 != 3600) with the fix disabled via `if False`, passes with it. Also B51e4b4df46: ev lacked failed hook names; failed_checks() now parses them.
guidance read at claim; helpers are pure (services/workers, services/gates/baseline), no new external dependency (r-adapters), no new knob, files under 30 KB.

Tests in tests/test_auto_workers.py and tests/test_baseline_red_auto.py failed before (AttributeError / wrong timeout), pass after. (2) already on branch main via 419d7a858 (_keep_cut_failing_ids); (3) local failing_ids_file already exists, blob link filed as follow-up.
